ideas.title: Uncovering the Extent of Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate the multiple cases of fraud in Minnesota, including the $1.4 million public benefits scheme and the $9B Somali fraud.
questions: What is the full extent of the fraud in Minnesota?
How are the different cases connected?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a large-scale fraud scheme in Minnesota, and further investigation is needed to expose the truth.
